Copies or recursively inserts a media entry, applying duplicate suppression and notifying the destination list. List flags are at +0x130/+0x131, versus +0x18c/+0x18d in the reviewed 2.0.4 counterpart 0x080c69c4. Other list fields require separate verification.
2.0.1 list flags at +0x130; corresponding 2.0.4 access uses +0x18c.
2.0.1 list order flags at +0x131; corresponding 2.0.4 access uses +0x18d.
Order field 0x1000 compares unsigned song shuffle ranks at entry +0x24; group entries are distinguished by byte +0x1d bit 0. Mode 2 selects this field.
Frees and clears cached indexes for order modes 1..48. Entry-array cache base is list+0x34c, so mode 2 uses +0x354; 2.0.4 uses +0x3b4. Auxiliary caches for modes 6, 7, 9 and 24 are also invalidated.
OSOS_GAME_MANIFEST_INIT_CALL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Allocates the resource override map and stores it at bank+0x18. Called by UI_InitResourceProviders before constructing resource providers. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x08111d0c.
Lazily constructs and returns the 0x54-byte Genius service. Its layout differs from the 0x58-byte 2.0.4 service. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x08121854.
Fills a media item from the Genius list at +0x4c; leaves output unchanged when the list is absent. 2.0.4 uses list field +0x30. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x08121884.
Subtracts two header rows when service byte +0x44 is zero, otherwise one. 2.0.4 reads the corresponding flag at +0x54. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x08121f88.
Under the player lock at +0xa4c, releases the prepared track at +0x58 and clears its pointer. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x08171110; these player offsets match.
Lazily allocates and constructs the 0xa6c-byte media player and returns the cached singleton at 0x089a012c. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x08171fdc.

Returns the default resource bank from the initialized resource service, or NULL when the service is unavailable. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x08194ed8.

Dispatches song-list action names; 0xdeadbeef queries support. Unrecognized actions fall through to the base media-list dispatcher. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x082176c0.

Builds the song context menu and saves the highlighted row at controller+0xd4. Item lookup uses model vtable+0x220, versus +0x22c in 2.0.4. Native eligibility omits the 2.0.4 kind-0x200000 check. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x08218014.
Appends HandleCancel to the song context menu. 2.0.4 payload hook counterpart: 0x08218188.
OSOS_SONG_CANCEL_APPEND_CALL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
OSOS_GENIUS_ACTION_ENTRY: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Dispatches Genius action names, including save and refresh; 0xdeadbeef queries support. Unrecognized actions fall through to the base media-list dispatcher. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x0821ac80.

Builds the Genius context menu using its row mapper and item getter; saves the highlighted row at controller+0xd4. Native eligibility omits the 2.0.4 kind-0x200000 check. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x0821bc68.
Appends HandleCancel to the Genius context menu. 2.0.4 payload hook counterpart: 0x0821be08.
OSOS_GENIUS_CANCEL_APPEND_CALL: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Dispatches settings action strings. Argument 0xdeadbeef queries support without executing; returns 0 for unrecognized actions and 1 for handled actions. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x0821c690.
OSOS_PLAYLIST_ACTION_ENTRY: reviewed native patch site for the build-selected OSOS shim.
Dispatches nested-playlist actions, including clear/save On-The-Go; 0xdeadbeef queries support. Unrecognized actions fall through to the base dispatcher. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x0822d1b8.

Builds the nested-playlist context menu and saves the highlighted row at controller+0xe8. Model list/item slots are +0x1ec/+0x220, versus +0x1f4/+0x22c in 2.0.4. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x0822e550.
Appends HandleCancel to the nested-playlist context menu. 2.0.4 payload hook counterpart: 0x0822e754.

Validates the item through vtable+8, then tests bit 8 of the 16-bit record field at +0xba. 2.0.4 uses a 32-bit field at +0xbc. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x082990ec.
Validates the item through vtable+8, then tests mask 0x8062 in the 16-bit record field at +0xba. 2.0.4 uses a 32-bit field at +0xbc. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x082991f0.
Validates the item through vtable+8, then returns record byte +0x8f bit 0; returns zero for an invalid item. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x0829969c.

Returns the playback entry at a validated index, accounting for shuffle and reversal. Uses list root +0x40, flags +0x130/+0x131 and cache +0x34c+4*mode; mode 2 is +0x354. Entry array begins at cache+0x10.
Returns the pointer held by a shared-object handle, or NULL when the handle has no backing object. Used for the song controller model at +0xb4. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x083cb174.
Releases reference-counted string backing storage, preserving the empty-string singleton and freeing storage when its last reference is released. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x083cdc2c.
Initializes a one-pointer string from NUL-terminated text, using shared empty storage for an empty input and allocated storage otherwise. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x083cdc84.
Finds or inserts the string key in a resource-name map and returns its ID slot; new values initialize to zero. ResourceName_GetId supplies map 0x08ac2d24. Reviewed counterpart: 2.0.4 0x083d0884.

Branches to the IRAM reset entry at 0x22008848.

Copies 0xae5c bytes into IRAM at 0x22000000, clears IRAM BSS, relocates the return address, then copies 0x9fad50 bytes into DRAM at 0x08000000 and 0xa84 bytes into 0x089fad50. Restarts through the relocated reset vector.
Clears the startup zero-initialized regions, including 0x12665c bytes of DRAM BSS at 0x089fb7d4.
Initializes the startup stack and branches to OS initialization at 0x220039e0.
